title: LLM Supplier Behavioral Audit & Transition Readiness Plan
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Produce a prioritized, evidence-backed audit of incumbent and emergent LLM suppliers focusing on behavioral risk (availability, degradations, API stability, feature drift), plus a concrete transition readiness plan to move traffic or fall back quickly with minimal customer impact. This ticket covers hypothesis generation, data collection, synthesis, and a short runbook for traffic re-routing and SLA negotiations. Deliverables: 1) Supplier behavior scorecard for top 12 providers; 2) Transition readiness checklist per supplier variant; 3) One-page executive summary for GTM and sales enablement; 4) Minimum viable fallback automation spec for SDK and Console teams.
tasks: Define supplier behavior metrics and data sources (uptime, error burst frequency, API delta, token latency distribution, new-feature churn)
Instrument and collect 90-day synthetic workload results against representative prompts (short chat, long context, embeddings)
Pull incident and outage feeds (Status pages, vendor Slack, Twitter signals) and map to customer-impact buckets
Construct 12-supplier scorecard and normalize across regions and quantized variants
Interview SRE and Account teams for 5 high-value customers to capture tolerance thresholds and migration pain points
Draft transition readiness checklist: model compatibility matrix, token/economics delta, auth/contract triggers, rollout steps
Prototype SDK fallback flag semantics and console UI state for forced fallback/rollbacks
Write one-page executive summary and distribute to Sales and Solutions within 2 weeks
Schedule review with Legal for contractual remediation options and SLAs
success_metrics: Scorecard completed for 12 suppliers with region/variant normalization
Transition checklist validated by SRE and Solutions engineering
Fallback automation spec accepted by SDK and Console (PR created)
Two enterprise customers have documented migration tolerance and runway
